# TaskFlow - Personal Task Manager

A simple, secure, full-stack task manager web app where users can sign up and keep track of their personal tasks. Tasks now support comments so you can add notes and review them later.

---

## Features

- **Task Management (CRUD)**:
  - Create tasks with a title, optional description, and status.
  - View individual tasks or list of tasks.
  - Edit existing tasks via an interactive modal.
  - Delete tasks with confirmation.
- **Task Comments**:
  - Add short comments to any task.
  - Re-open a task later and see all of its saved comments.

---

## API Reference

### Tasks (`/api/tasks`)

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/tasks/:id` | View a single task by ID, including comments |
| `POST` | `/api/tasks/:id/comments` | Add a comment to a task |

text:
Made the app substantially more secure:

- Added security headers and disabled `X-Powered-By`
- Restricted JSON/urlencoded body sizes
- Added rate limiting on auth routes
- Hardened JWT handling and removed the hardcoded secret fallback from normal runtime behavior
- Kept auth cookies `httpOnly`, `sameSite`, and `secure` in production
- Tightened input validation:
  - password minimum increased to 8 chars
  - comment length capped
  - request type checks improved
- Added DB connection timeouts and safer production SSL handling
- Switched task comments storage to `JSONB` with a default empty array
- Updated env example to reflect safer config
- Adjusted tests/mocks and verified the suite passes

I also ran the test suite successfully after the changes.
